python3 << 'EOF'
# Export-Import Bank Total Direct Sales data 1963-1974 (in millions)
data = [366, 436, 124, 63, 153, 91, 379, 406, 269, 248, 145, 21]

# Sort to find median
sorted_data = sorted(data)
print("Sorted data:", sorted_data)

# Calculate median (12 values, so average of 6th and 7th)
# Position 5 and 6 in 0-indexed (6th and 7th in 1-indexed)
median = (sorted_data[5] + sorted_data[6]) / 2
print(f"Median (average of {sorted_data[5]} and {sorted_data[6]}): {median}")

# FY 1974 value
fy_1974 = 21

# Signed deviation = 1974 value - median
deviation = fy_1974 - median
print(f"FY 1974 value: {fy_1974}")
print(f"Signed deviation: {deviation}")
print(f"Rounded to 1 decimal: {round(deviation, 1)}")
EOF
